name: IASC-ASCE Benchmark Structure
description: Compares damage-detection methods on the standard IASC-ASCE benchmark structure using the SHETM approach.
reputation: A standard, well-cited laboratory/experimental benchmark in structural health monitoring research used for comparing damage-detection methods, especially in academic studies.
notes: Small, laboratory-scale dataset with limited diversity; primarily a non-LLM structural engineering benchmark. Results may not generalize to all real-world structures.
